title: Three Steps. That's All It Takes.
description: Most liquidity providers spend hours searching for profitable wallets, analyzing positions, and managing their strategies manually. YieldSync helps you discover high-performing LPs and automatically copy their strategies in just a few minutes.

steps.title: Create & Fund Your Trading Wallet
steps.description: Create your non-custodial trading wallet in seconds. Securely powered by Privy, your wallet stays under your control while YieldSync automates your strategies.

steps.title: Find High-Performing LP Wallets
steps.description: Discover profitable liquidity providers using YieldSync Wallet Intel or research wallets with your favorite analytics tools like LP Agent, Solscan, or Meteora.

steps.title: Build Your Strategy & Copy Automatically
steps.description: Choose the wallets you want to follow, customize your filters and strategy settings, and let YieldSync automatically mirror their liquidity actions—all while you stay in full control of your funds.
